title: Platform SDK
summary: In-place L1 feature pack for publish-target to platform-SDK adapter mapping, C-owned SDK facade, selected web SDK backends, runtime identity/capabilities, artifact inspection, and local analytics scorecards.
dependencies: features/ui-kit for src/platform_sdk_debug.c only (the mock portal modal and probe panel)
features/game-events L0 event/analytics spine for SDK event bridging
Node.js for platform-sdk tests and scorecard/artifact CLIs
provides: shared bounded Web crash delivery and pre-runtime diagnostics without a second engine journal
target-to-platform-sdk mapping
C-owned game-facing PlatformSdk wrapper contract
build-time adapter selection
runtime target and SDK identity
policy capabilities such as externalLinksAllowed
selected backend call semantics for mock, Poki, Yandex Games, Playgama, CrazyGames, and Wavedash
C/template mock ad overlays for local development
internal bounded measure sink for typed game-event bridges
portal player storage bridge for cloud saves
portal-driven pause and resume, and the portal language, bridged into C
player identity and portal login (Yandex auth dialog, local mock), the auth.changed event and the auth result measure; no logout seam

portal leaderboards behind one C surface (caps, submit, fetch, open, one listener): Yandex read/write behind login with the portal quotas enforced in the adapter, CrazyGames write-only with AES-GCM scores, Playgama capability read from bridge.leaderboards.type at run time, local mock canned board, Wavedash read/write without a login behind a name-to-id board resolve
publish target manifest validation
local NDJSON scorecard CLI
request-correlated storage transport with explicit outcomes and native backend injection
canonical target descriptors and compilation-profile-bound release artifacts
Closure externs of the web bridge names and platform_sdk_closure_externs(<target>) to link them
portal lifecycle signals from the frame's input edge, tick and first presented frame (platform_lifecycle.h)
attention/ad clock freeze, mixer mute edge and the two ad points with one-video-one-reward (platform_hooks.h, game audio and log as callbacks)
the hand-answered mock portal of a native local build (platform_sdk_mock.h) and its ui-kit modal and probe panel (platform_sdk_debug.h)
DevAPI game.platform_sdk.state and platform.state/attention/break/reward

flags.debug_ui: off in release, on by explicit/debug build

registers.note: Describes the template's existing in-place wiring; this feature is selected by CMake GAME_PUBLISH_TARGET.
